piezas.titulo: Listen: Numbers, age and basic details
texto: Listening to numbers and personal details: in spoken Thai, numbers are pronounced with clearly different vowels: «หนึ่ง» [nʉ̀ng, closed vowel], «สอง» [sɔ̌ɔng, long open vowel], «สาม» [sǎam, long vowel]. When you hear an age such as «อายุยี่สิบปี», notice the sound of «ยี่สิบ» (twenty; *สองสิบ is never said) followed by «ปี» [bpii]. Training your ear with these sequences avoids confusion with dates and prices.

opciones.texto: Being twenty years old (อายุยี่สิบปี)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: «ยี่สิบ» is the numeral 20 and «ปี» indicates years of age.

opciones.texto: Being two years old (อายุสองปี)
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: two is «สอง», whereas the phrase says «ยี่สิบ».
